heading: Memory and learning
description: Memories and procedures share one global store in SQLite across all workspaces of this Nanachi installation on this PC, available only to authorized agents. Tools identify the current workspace automatically from the session; memories are never added automatically to your prompts.
consent: Automatic reviews use the selected model and may incur charges. Conversation excerpts, the current workspace and relevant global memories with their origins are sent to that provider; a local endpoint keeps inference on your configured server.
emptyAgents: No ACP agents are configured on this PC.
mcpHint: Memory tools also require Nanachi MCP to be enabled for the agent. Learning does not change its MCP preference.

sources.same: Same model and account as the conversation

sameHint: Uses the original turn's model and account in an isolated review, only when the agent supports safe tool-free inference. Unsupported agents report an error rather than running an unsafe review.
manualHint: If model listing is unavailable, enter the exact model ID supported by this endpoint.
noModels: No models were listed for this selection.
modelsFailed: Could not refresh models. Try again.
endpointHint: Use the address reachable from this PC, not from your phone. Save the connection before refreshing models.
keyConfigured: A key is stored for the saved connection. Leave blank to keep it at the same endpoint. Changing the provider or URL removes it unless you enter a new key; its value is never returned.
keyEmpty: No key is stored. Keys are sent only when you save and are never kept in browser storage.
saved: Learning settings saved on this PC.
loadFailed: Could not load learning settings. Try again.
saveFailed: Could not confirm the save. Your changes are still here; try saving again.
scope: All workspaces in this Nanachi installation share this list. Origins identify where entries came from, not where they can be used. Forgetting an entry removes it from future retrieval across workspaces, but does not erase the source conversation.
empty: No memories or procedures match this selection.
memoryFailed: Could not load global memory. Try again.
writeFailed: Could not confirm this change. Reload the list before trying again if another device edited it.
title: Title
forgetHint: It will no longer be offered to agents. This does not erase its source conversation.

notice.failedHint: No learning changes were confirmed. Check the reviewer connection, model and agent support in Settings.
notice.actionFailed: Could not confirm the action. Try again; later edits may prevent reversal.
notice.unavailable: This entry is no longer available.
